name: 3-Way Gauntlet
summary: Players cross the field through three defender lanes to reach a protected safe zone, timing their movement to avoid being tagged.

name: Adventure Quest
summary: Multiple teams compete to collect and control every crystal in the valley — battle, rescue teammates, protect crystal carriers, and eliminate opposing teams to become quest champions.

name: Bizzerk
summary: A multi-stage survival gauntlet where Super Moverz navigate a changing forest maze, avoid Space Monkey ambush zones, and defend a central fortress from explosive attacks.

name: Castle Crush
summary: Teams race across the arena to enter the opposing castle, take on structured roles, and finally escort the Royal safely across the field.

name: Charge
summary: Two opposing armies race across enemy territory while battling for control of scattered Zeapons and battlefield resources.

name: Coco Nuts
summary: Trapped on Monkey Island, Super Moverz dribble coconuts with their Zabers while avoiding Gaby the Gorilla, protecting coconuts and rescuing teammates.

name: Crystal Capture
summary: Royal Teams compete to collect all three Unity Crystals scattered across the battlefield — balance offense, defense, rescues, and Zeapon control while protecting your own crystal.

name: Dragon Slayer
summary: In Woodsy the Wizard's magical valley, Dragons work together to recover their stolen eggs from Dragon Slayers and return safely to the nest before time expires.

name: Gator Gamble
summary: Super Moverz work together to retrieve Unity Crystals from a guarded island while avoiding roaming Gators protecting the riverways.

name: Hunting Party
summary: A giant hide-and-seek survival mission where Hunters search for hidden Super Moverz and grow their team by recruiting tagged players into the Hunting Party.

name: Island Crossfire
summary: Super Moverz navigate a dangerous obstacle course while avoiding incoming attacks from Space Monkeys stationed around the island pathways.

name: Jackal Hassle
summary: Super Moverz sprint between safe zones while avoiding hidden Jackals in the crossing lanes. Each tagged player joins the Jackal pack, so the danger grows every round.

name: Meteor Shower
summary: Players travel across a rectangular movement zone while avoiding flying meteors thrown by Space Monkeys. Tagged players join the Space Monkeys until only one runner remains.

name: Pickle Frog Rescue
summary: Players leave their base to cross guarded territory, rescue the captured Pickle Frog, and return safely before time expires while avoiding Void Jail Guards.

name: Pirate Ship
summary: Two opposing teams defend their ships while launching cannon balls across the water to land inside the opposing ship. Scuba Divers retrieve loose cannon balls and return them to their team.

name: Raiders
summary: A fast-action team battle where a Zaber team and a dodge ball team coordinate rescues and use battlefield cover to overpower each other.

name: River Crosser
summary: Teams work together to build pathways across dangerous lava fields using limited equipment, battling for control of islands to complete the crossing mission.

name: Robo Shark
summary: Players move freely inside a boundary while avoiding Robo Sharks who attempt to tag them using controlled movement and awareness.

name: Role Player Survivor
summary: Teams compete in rotating battles using assigned equipment roles before progressing into full-team elimination rounds where rescue strategy decides who survives.

name: Royal Rescue
summary: Two Royal Families battle to escort their Royal safely across the battlefield and into the opposing castle, progressing through multiple rounds of increasing strategy and equipment.

name: Space Base
summary: Super Moverz leave their protected base to recover scattered Power Crystals while avoiding roaming villains, coordinating rescues and returning safely before time expires.

name: Sportnite
summary: Players enter a free-movement arena to collect equipment and compete in a survival challenge with reboot mechanics. As the storm closes in, players return to the shrinking battle zone for a final showdown.

name: Super Seeker
summary: Players move across the play space attempting to return safely to base while avoiding Seekers. Tagged players power down until rescued by teammates.

name: Survivor
summary: Players move inside a circular boundary attempting to tag opponents below the waist using controlled Zaber contact while advancing through cooperative and competitive mission levels.

name: Swamp Trap
summary: Super Moverz hop between Lily Pads and Rocks while avoiding swamp creatures, staying active on safe surfaces as villains increase pressure each level.

name: Troopers Vs. Jedi
summary: Players start as Jedi in a zone avoiding balls by blocking projectiles from Troopers. If a Jedi is hit, they drop their Zaber and become a Trooper.

name: Zorb Lord
summary: A boss-battle mission where Super Moverz work together to defeat powerful multi-life villains before time expires.
